name: workspace
description: The Workspace: your files on a cluster in the browser, with an editor, viewers for images, HTML, PDFs and movies, terminals, and job scripts built from templates (uv, pixi, a venv or conda) and submitted with sbatch. Runs on the login node as you.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Your files on the cluster with an editor and viewers, terminals, and job submission from script templates. It runs on the login node as you, with your full permissions (not the agents' sandbox); only the console's Open (which carries its token) gets in.

settings.name: WORKSPACE_ROOT
settings.label: Start in
settings.hint: the directory it opens in; empty: your home directory

settings.name: WORKSPACE_PYTHON
settings.label: Python
settings.hint: Python 3.6 or newer on the login node; default python3

settings.name: WORKSPACE_EDIT_LIMIT_MB
settings.label: Editor limit (MB)
settings.hint: the largest file the editor opens; default 800

settings.name: WORKSPACE_CONFIRM_MB
settings.label: Ask above (MB)
settings.hint: it asks before opening a file larger than this; default 20

settings.name: WORKSPACE_CDN
settings.label: CDN
settings.hint: where CodeMirror and xterm.js load from (an npm mirror); default https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm
